text:
nora_marketing: Quick thread to lock down SolaceMed case study flow. Need interview slot, hero quote, and legal sign-off timeline. Target: blog + webinar in 3 weeks.

raj_cs: Customer available Mon 9am PT or Thu 2pm PT. They prefer Thu.

nora_marketing: Thu 2pm PT works for our producer. I'll reserve 30–40 minutes and request a short product demo clip + headshot.

owen_prod: Please do not put proprietary throughput numbers in hero. If they want to mention latency, use the vetted line from infra: "measured 2.8x improvement in p99 latency" and attach bench logs.

talia_legal: Legal checklist: signed release (customer countersign), attach benchmark logs, and approval of final quoted text. Send draft release to the customer and cc legal@redwood. We need signed copy before publish.

raj_cs: Adding release to invite now and asking them to countersign pre-call.

nora_marketing: Producer pre-call 15 min before. Will run through hero prompts: 1) one-line impact 2) why Redwood Dedicated 3) measurable outcome.

ops-bot: Upload note: tag assets with #solacemed-case and set retention=90d.

nowen_prod: Exact phrasing to paste: "In our tests, Redwood Dedicated measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency for SolaceMed's recommendation service."

talia_legal: OK with that phrasing pending log attachments. Also propose alternative hero wording to avoid absolutes: "SolaceMed measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency when using Redwood Dedicated."

nora_marketing: I'll draft two hero variants after we get the transcript. Diego (raj), confirm the invite and let us know when release is signed.

raj_cs: Invite confirmed; release countersigned by erin@solacemed.com.

nora_marketing: Great. Next steps: 1) pre-brief (nora) 2) interview Thu 2pm (nora/raj) 3) capture hero + 2 supporting bullets (owen) 4) legal review post-transcript (talia) 5) upload assets + embargo 48h (nora).

talia_legal: I'll review quotes after transcript upload. Please tag me in-thread when done.

nora_marketing: Will post hero options in here within 24 hours of call. If anyone has alternate wording suggestions now, drop them. Otherwise I'll post after transcription. :sparkles:
